the GSTT1 null genotype is a risk factor for lung cancer in smokers and in nonsmokers and that GSTM1 is a risk factor only in smokers.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the GSTM1 null genotype, the GSTP1 Ile105Val polymorphism, and the GSTT1 null genotype are not associated with the incidence of cancer in the Finnish population.
the GSTM1 null allele is not associated with increased cancer risk.
the GSTM1 null genotype is associated with a higher risk of cancer and GSTM1 and GSTT1 polymorphisms may modify the risk of developing cancer.
